name: soft_string_weight1.k
model:
class SoftString1 {
  s:String

  req s = "red" || s = "green" || s = "blue"

  soft req s = "red"

  soft req s = "blue" weight 5

  soft req s = "green" weight 2
}

main:SoftString1
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((SoftString1 (mk-SoftString1 (s String)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-SoftString1 (sel-SoftString1 SoftString1))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-SoftString1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-SoftString1 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-SoftString1 ((this Ref)) SoftString1
  (sel-SoftString1 (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-SoftString1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-SoftString1 this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.main: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ----------------------------------
;   Getters for class SoftString1:
; ----------------------------------

; --- getters for SoftString1.s: ---

(define-fun SoftString1!s ((this Ref)) String
  (s (deref-SoftString1 this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-SoftString1 (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; ------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class SoftString1:
; ------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-SoftString1 SoftString1)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun SoftString1.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or (or (= (SoftString1!s this) "red") (= (SoftString1!s this) "green")) (= (SoftString1!s this) "blue"))
)

(assert (! (SoftString1.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Soft Constraint 2: ---

(define-fun SoftString1.soft2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (SoftString1!s this) "red")
)

(assert-soft (SoftString1.soft2 1) :weight 1 :id k_soft)

; --- Soft Constraint 3: ---

(define-fun SoftString1.soft3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (SoftString1!s this) "blue")
)

(assert-soft (SoftString1.soft3 1) :weight 5 :id k_soft)

; --- Soft Constraint 4: ---

(define-fun SoftString1.soft4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (SoftString1!s this) "green")
)

(assert-soft (SoftString1.soft4 1) :weight 2 :id k_soft)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-SoftString1 const-1-SoftString1))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-SoftString1 a!1)))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun const-1-SoftString1 () SoftString1
  (mk-SoftString1 "blue"))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (= (s (sel-SoftString1 (select heap 1))) "red"))
      (a!2 (= (s (sel-SoftString1 (select heap 1))) "green"))
      (a!3 (= (s (sel-SoftString1 (select heap 1))) "blue")))
  (or a!1 a!2 a!3)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-SoftString1 (mk-SoftString1 "blue"))))
